name: egat-cbank-optimizer
description: Client-side tool for rebalancing EGAT ungrounded double-wye capacitor banks. Computes neutral unbalance current (I_no) using the complex-phasor method and suggests the fewest capacitor swaps to bring I_no below the 50 mA relay threshold.

scripts.dev: node build.js && echo 'Open dist/egat-cbank.html in a browser'
